meta.scope: Philippines Batch 3 — IT-BPM / BPO industry (second global hub after India), regional economic concentration (NCR + CALABARZON), and agriculture/rice production core.

candidates.title: IT-BPM / BPO industry statistics and performance
candidates.description: Industry statistics on the Information Technology and Business Process Management sector — revenues (recently ~USD 40+ billion), headcount (~1.8–1.9 million FTEs), global market share, and sub-sector composition (customer experience, healthcare, IT services, etc.). Philippines ranks as the world’s second-largest IT-BPM delivery geography after India.
referenced_by: Labour Force Survey and employment analysis
candidates.notes: High-centrality uniqueness node. Alongside OFW remittances, IT-BPM is a defining export of Philippine services and human capital.

candidates.title: IT-BPM policy and investment-promotion framing
candidates.description: Policy and investment-promotion framing that treats IT-BPM as a strategic growth sector, including incentives, talent development and the push toward higher-value / AI-augmented services.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the industry performance node.

candidates.title: National Capital Region (NCR) Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for the National Capital Region — the dominant services and administrative core of the Philippine economy.

candidates.title: CALABARZON Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for CALABARZON — major industrial and manufacturing belt adjacent to NCR, frequently accounting for a large share of national industry output and ranking among the largest regional economies.
candidates.notes: Primary industrial-belt regional output node. Together with NCR forms the Luzon economic core.

candidates.title: Philippine regional economic structure (Luzon–Visayas–Mindanao)
candidates.publisher: Derived from PSA GRDP and related series
candidates.description: System-level view of the three major island-group economies and the concentration of output in Luzon (especially NCR + CALABARZON). Provides the spatial organising frame for later provincial densification.

candidates.title: Agriculture and fisheries production statistics
candidates.description: Official value and volume of production in agriculture and fisheries. Crops (especially rice/palay) dominate; livestock, poultry and fisheries complete the sector.

candidates.title: Rice / palay production statistics
candidates.description: Official palay (unmilled rice) production volume and related indicators. Rice remains the central food-security crop and a politically sensitive commodity; weather, irrigation and import policy strongly affect outcomes.
referenced_by: CPI food component and inflation analysis

candidates.title: Philippines IT-BPM–regional–agriculture densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from IBPAP/IBOB, PSA GRDP and agriculture sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding IT-BPM industry performance and policy framing, NCR and CALABARZON GRDP, broader Luzon–Visayas–Mindanao regional structure, agriculture/fisheries production, and rice/palay statistics into a coherent services-export, spatial-concentration and food-security layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, labour and poverty series from earlier batches
